title: Fomo Kernel Pre-Trade Consultation
description: One row per `review.py consider` call (docs/decision-fomo-kernel-shape.md Layer 2): a user mid-decision asks what a hypothetical trade does to their book, away from any review session. The readable contract; skills/fomo-kernel/engine/review.py's cmd_consider holds the enforcement, because the offline suite carries no jsonschema dependency. Stored in <root>/pre_trade_consultations.jsonl, append-only. Every field is a frozen value computed at the time of the ask, never a pointer into mutable state -- the ledger keeps growing after this row is written, and a later reconciliation must see what the engine actually said then, not what it would say now (the frozen-subject design ratified in issue #446's specification comment). A resolution (`--resolve`) appends a new row carrying the same consultation_id rather than rewriting this one; the fold picks whichever row for that id appears last in the file.

consultation_id.description: Engine-assigned, content-addressed identity (consult-<hash of premise+basis+created>), the same convention session.py uses for snapshot_id/adjustment_id/reconciliation_id. Asking the identical premise again the same day against an unchanged book converges on the same id rather than minting a new one.

created.description: The date this consultation was asked (today, at CLI invocation time) -- distinct from premise.date, which is when the hypothetical trade itself would happen.

premise.description: The normalized hypothetical trade consequence.validate_premise() returned: ticker, side, qty, price, date, currency. notional, when the caller supplied it, is already consumed into qty by validation time and never appears here.

basis.description: What book this consultation was computed against (issue #456). A pre-trade question cannot demand a fresh CSV the way a review can, so the record must say its own footing rather than imply a currency it does not have.

source.description: ledger: reconstructed from <root>/ledger.jsonl (the snapshot anchor plus trades after it). transactions: the caller supplied CSV paths directly, read through trade_recap.load().

as_of.description: The date of the record's own latest row -- the last trade or snapshot anchor the reconstructed book actually reflects.

stale_days.description: created minus as_of, in days. Disclosed, never gated on -- issue #456 leaves the question of an interruption-worthy threshold explicitly unresolved; a large value means the answer is confidently computed on a record that may no longer match the real book, not that the answer was refused.

consequence.description: The frozen return of engine/consequence.py's consequence(). before/after/delta are not restated field-by-field here -- that shape belongs to consequence.py alone, the same posture session-bundle.schema.json takes toward engine_state/engine_card.

before.description: portfolio_state() over the book alone. See consequence.py for the field contract.

after.description: portfolio_state() over the book plus the hypothetical trade. See consequence.py for the field contract.

delta.description: Signed after-minus-before changes for the readings that moved; a field absent here did not move. See consequence.py's _delta().

disclosures.description: Machine-readable limitation keys, mirroring consequence.DISCLOSURES. Locale wording belongs in renderer copy, never here (CLAUDE.md, "Honesty decisions belong in code").

rule_collisions.description: One row per currently-tracked rule, mirroring engine/consequence.py's rule_collision(). A muted rule is excluded, matching the rotation it opted out of.

text.description: The rule's own text, verbatim, as stored on rules.jsonl.

problem_key.description: null means this rule's metric_key has no mechanical mapping at all -- state is unmapped, never a silent pass.

state.description: Mirrors consequence.COLLISION_STATES. would_breach: this trade is what freshly crosses the line. already_over: the book was already over the line and stays there, with or without this trade being the cause -- never read as this trade breaking the rule. unjudged: a metric this module cannot evaluate from one hypothetical trade (exit_severity, hold_severity). unmapped: problem_key is null.

worsens.description: Set only when state is already_over: whether this trade moves the relevant reading in the bad direction. null everywhere else -- a boolean that means nothing outside one state is worse than an absent one.

decision.description: What the user did with this consultation. open until a --resolve call records one of the other three; never rewritten in place -- --resolve appends a new row with the same consultation_id.

decided_on.description: The date --resolve recorded a decision (ISO date), or null while decision is open.

agent_case.description: Optional structured case for and against the trade, supplied by the caller through --agent-case. Never required, and never free prose -- owner ruling 2026-07-27: the agent lists the case for and against and does not take a position, so a submission missing either side is refused rather than accepted one-sided.

claim.description: One sentence, the caller's own words.

provenance.description: docs/decision-fomo-kernel-shape.md Layer 3: mark each claim as your record says (engine_fact), public fact, or my judgment (agent_judgment) -- per-sentence provenance rather than a blanket disclaimer.
